correctness.rationale: The class count (2^n+2^ceil(n/2))/2 is a reversal-involution count. Every covering cycle has a 0^n window, so fixing one root loses no solutions. Inspected verify_dp.py and verify_census.py: the former traverses all class bitmasks and n−1-bit suffixes with all n−1 closing windows; the latter directly enumerates every 0^n-rooted binary suffix for every L from n through the claimed minimum, deduplicates rotations and both symmetries, and checks both attached optimal-cycle lists. An independently written exhaustive implementation recomputed for n=1..5 the shortest lengths 2,4,8,14,26, class counts 2,3,6,10,20, optimal cycles 1,1,2,8,128, and bracelet counts 1,1,1,3,36. With all shorter candidates checked, this is an exhaustive proof only for n<=5. Equality of rooted and necklace optima also verifies one occurrence of 0^n in each optimum.
residual_risks: No all-order claim beyond n=5; proof depends on complete exact finite search and correct closing windows.
